description: This file implements a SharedService class for managing shared worker communication, client-provider messaging via BroadcastChannel, MessagePort handling, and locking mechanisms within the Notesnook project. It facilitates inter-context communication and service activation/deactivation.

classes.name: SharedService
classes.description: A generic class managing shared worker communication, client/provider messaging, and proxying method calls over MessagePorts.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SharedService instance, sets up messaging channels, and creates a proxy for remote method invocation.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the service as a provider, establishing communication ports, listening for client requests, and managing provider lifecycle.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the service provider, aborting ongoing operations.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the service, rejecting pending callbacks and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: #sendPortToClient
methods.description: Sends a MessagePort to the client via service worker or shared worker.

methods.name: #getClientId
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a unique client ID, using locks and service worker messaging.

methods.name: #providerChange
methods.description: Handles provider transition by requesting a MessagePort and setting up message handlers.

methods.name: #resendPendingCallbacks
methods.description: Resends queued callbacks to the current provider port.

methods.name: #createProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy object to intercept method calls and route them via MessagePort.

methods.name: getProviderPort
methods.description: Ensures a valid provider port is available for communication, with retries.
